label: The Library of Leonardo da Vinci: A Reconstructed Catalogue (project page)
citation: Identity of Leonardo da Vinci, The Library of Leonardo da Vinci: A Reconstructed Catalogue, 125 titles, project web page (site/views/library.html), compiled from Vecce (ed.) 2019, the Museo Galileo digital library and Leonardo's autograph book lists.

claims.statement: A compiled research page of this project. It is reference material, not a ground: every entry points to Leonardo's autograph book lists (Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r) and to Vecce (ed.) 2019, which are where an identification must be checked.
